definitions.explanation: An umbrella specifically designed for use in the rain, as opposed to a parasol or sun umbrella.

examples.japanese: {雨傘|あまがさ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}って→持つ：00478_motsu⟧きた。
⟦{黒|くろ}い→黒い：00588_kuroi⟧{雨傘|あまがさ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought a black rain umbrella.

examples.japanese: ⟦{折|お}りたたみ→折りたたみ：11332_oritatami⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{雨傘|あまがさ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かばん→かばん：00637_kaban⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れて→入れる：01098_ireru⟧おく⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{便利|べんり}→便利：00830_benri⟧だ。
examples.english: It's convenient to keep a folding rain umbrella in your bag.

notes:
Distinguishes a rain umbrella from a ⟦{日傘|ひがさ}→日傘：04686_higasa⟧ (parasol/sun umbrella). While ⟦{傘|かさ}→傘：00639_kasa⟧ alone usually implies a rain umbrella, {雨傘|あまがさ} is used when the distinction matters.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {雨傘|あまがさ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{差|さ}す→差す：17637_sasu⟧ — to put up a rain umbrella
- {折|お}りたたみ{雨傘|あまがさ} — folding rain umbrella
- {雨傘|あまがさ}{立|た}て — umbrella stand

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{傘|かさ}→傘：00639_kasa⟧ — umbrella (general term, usually implies rain umbrella)
- ⟦{日傘|ひがさ}→日傘：04686_higasa⟧ — parasol, sun umbrella
- {相合傘|あいあいがさ} — sharing an umbrella (romantic connotation)
